Where a Member cancels a monthly subscription, the fee already paid for the current billing cycle is non-refundable, and the Member may continue to use the Service until the next renewal date (the end of the current billing cycle).

The number of months used shall be calculated by rounding up the period from the commencement of use to the date of the cancellation request to whole months, and any partially used month shall be counted as one full month.b.

Where a separate individual agreement (including a customized agreement such as an Enterprise contract) has been concluded, the cancellation and refund terms set forth in that agreement shall prevail over this Article.Chapter 4.

The Company shall not be liable for information leakage or damages resulting from violations.(3) Members must comply with obligations under these Terms, written contracts, detailed guidelines, and applicable laws.

Usar ‘garantía’ sin KPI, plazo, exclusiones y remedio.
